Name: Morning Quality of Life
Author: SamirBalaNet
Description:
[size=5][b]Morning Quality of Life (Stardew Valley 1.6+)[/b][/size]
An all-in-one, highly configurable Quality of Life mod built from scratch for Stardew Valley 1.6. Every single feature can be toggled or customized in-game via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].

[line]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]1. Realistic Morning Routine[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Custom Wake-Up Time:[/b] Choose any wake-up time between [b]03:00 and 13:00[/b] (in 10-minute intervals), or enable [b]Random Wake-Up Time[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Full Stamina on Wake-Up:[/b] Restores 100% of your energy upon waking up, even if you went to sleep at 02:00 AM.[/*]
[*][b]Early Morning Lighting:[/b] Softly darkens the outdoors at 03:00 (matching late-night ambiance) and gradually brightens until sunrise at 06:00.[/*]
[*][b]Realistic Family & Animal Schedules:[/b] If you wake up before 06:00, your spouse and children stay asleep in bed and barn/coop doors stay closed until 06:00, when everyone wakes up and animals go outside normally.[/*]
[/list]
[b]2. Selective Automatic Gates[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Per-Gate Control:[/b] Press the configured key (default: [b][color=#ff7700]G[/color][/b]) near any fence gate to choose whether that specific gate should be [b]Automatic[/b] or [b]Manual[/b] (saved per playthrough).[/*]
[*][b]Double Gate Sync & Horse-Friendly Delay:[/b] Automatically syncs double gates and lets you configure the closing delay (ms) so gates never close on you while riding a horse.[/*]
[/list]
[b]3. Complete Fishing Assists[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Infallible Fishing:[/b] Prevents the catch bar from dropping to zero and losing the fish.[/*]
[*][b]Trap Bobber Effect:[/b] Reduces fish escape speed by 66% without needing tackle equipped.[/*]
[*][b]Sonar Bobber Effect:[/b] Displays which fish is on the line during the minigame without needing tackle equipped.[/*]
[/list]
[b]4. Farming & Ranching QoL[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Till Grass Edges:[/b] Lets you hoe transition tiles between dirt and grass while still blocking 100% pure grass tiles.[/*]
[*][b]Prevent Double Watering:[/b] Stops you from wasting water and stamina on crops that are already watered, displaying a helpful HUD warning.[/*]
[*][b]Animal Color Selector:[/b] Adds clickable color buttons ([b]White[/b], [b]Brown[/b], and [b]Blue[/b] after Shane's 8-heart event) right above the naming box at Marnie's Ranch.[/*]
[*][b]Filtered Auto-Grabbers (including Truffles):[/b] Press [b][color=#ff7700]H[/color][/b] (configurable) near any Auto-Grabber to choose exactly what that machine collects—including [b]Truffles[/b] dug up by pigs outside on the farm![/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b]Requirements & Languages[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Required:[/b] [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/url][/*]
[*][b]Recommended:[/b] [url=https://nexusmods.com]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[*][b]Languages included:[/b] Portuguese (Default) and English.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b]Descrição em Português[/b][/size]
Mod completo de Qualidade de Vida para Stardew Valley 1.6, totalmente configurável pelo [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]:
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Rotina Matinal Realista:[/color][/b] Acorde entre [b][color=#ff7700]03:00 e 13:00[/color][/b] (ou horário aleatório) com energia 100% cheia, degradê escuro de madrugada até as 06:00, família dormindo até as 06:00 e portinholas dos animais abrindo automaticamente às 06:00.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Portões Automáticos Seletivos:[/color][/b] Aperte[color=#ff7700] [b]G[/b][/color] perto de qualquer portão para definir individualmente se ele será Automático ou Manual, com suporte a portões duplos e atraso configurável para passar a cavalo.[/*]
[*][b]Pesca Completa:[/b] Opções independentes para [b]Pesca Sem Falhas[/b], [b]Efeito Boia-armadilha[/b] e [b]Efeito Boia Sonar[/b].[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Agricultura e Animais:[/color][/b] Cave bordas de transição de grama com a enxada, evite gastar água/energia regando terra já molhada, escolha a cor de galinhas e vacas na Marnie e [color=#ff7700]aperte [b]H[/b] perto de qualquer Auto-Recolhedora para filtrar[/color] o que ela coleta (incluindo trufas na fazenda).[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Morning Quality of Life
Manifest.Description: Acorde mais cedo com energia cheia, configure portoes automaticos individuais, pesque com opcoes de boia/sonar e cave bordas de grama.
Manifest.Author: Samir
